Messages.Author: Piers
Messages.Body:
Could someone be so kinda as to answer a few questions that have come up in
a couple of recent games..

Is Burning Wrath a hand strike ?

If you use The Art of Love to take control of an ally does the ally untap ?

If your vampire is not a Tremere and you steal The Sword of Nuln the vampire
would still be able to use the sword I belilve, If this is the case does it
still apply to The Sword of Judgment which specifies "Only usable by a
Brujah Antitribu" in the card text also?

If you play Secure Haven on a vampire & then the vampire has Haven Uncovered
played on it - What effect does this have ?

Does playing Save Fave tap the vampire that playes it ?

Thanks very much

Piers

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Piers" <Piers-AT-blacklightcafe.co.uk> wrote in message
news:41f790a0$0$271$cc9e...@news.dial.pipex.com...

> Could someone be so kinda as to answer a few questions that have come up
in
> a couple of recent games..
>
> Is Burning Wrath a hand strike ?

Yes. It is a non-weapon, non-ranged strike that does damage based on the
striking minion's strength. Any strike that meets that definition is a
hand strike.

> If you use The Art of Love to take control of an ally does the ally untap
?

No. The only things that untap a minion are starting your untap phase and
card text.

> If your vampire is not a Tremere and you steal The Sword of Nuln the
vampire
> would still be able to use the sword I belilve, If this is the case does
it
> still apply to The Sword of Judgment which specifies "Only usable by a
> Brujah Antitribu" in the card text also?

Card text applies in both cases, yes.
Nuln places no restriction on the weilder. Judgment does.

> If you play Secure Haven on a vampire & then the vampire has Haven
Uncovered
> played on it - What effect does this have ?

The (D) action option given by the Haven Uncovered is still not
usable, since no (D) actions may be made against the Secured vampire.

> Does playing Save Fave tap the vampire that playes it ?

No. The only things that taps a minion are acting, successfully
blocking, and card text.

Messages.Author: geo...@for.auth.gr
Messages.Body:
Piers wrote:

>Is Burning Wrath a hand strike ?

yes, all strength based non ranged strikes (like Burn. Wrath) are hand
strikes.

>If you use The Art of Love to take control of an ally does the ally
untap ?

No, per card text. And from what i know this hasn't been changed.

>If your vampire is not a Tremere and you steal The Sword of Nuln the
vampire
would still be able to use the sword I belilve

correct

>, If this is the case does it
still apply to The Sword of Judgment which specifies "Only usable by a
Brujah Antitribu" in the card text also?

Sword of Judgement cannot be used by anyone who is not a Brujah
antitribu,
sword of Nuln does not have similar text, so it can be used by anyone,
though
it can be equipped only by a Tremere. So, you can equip it with a
Tremere,then
transfer it (e.g. via Heidelberg) to a vampire of another clan and it
will still be
perfectly usuable.

>If you play Secure Haven on a vampire & then the vampire has Haven
Uncovered
>played on it - What effect does this have ?

The methuselah playing the Haven Uncovered will burn 1 pool, but no
vampire
will be able to enter combat with the minion having the Secure Haven as
long
as Secure Haven remains in play and on that minion.

>Does playing Save Fave tap the vampire that playes it ?

No, combat cards by default are playable by tapped vampires and do not
tap
the minion that plays them, Save Face states that it requires an
untapped
vampire, but DOES NOT say that you should tap him, so the vampire
playing it
should be untapped, but playing it does not tap him.

George
